text:
Do you wish to be loved? Then do not lose

the course of your heart. Only what

you are must you be, and what you are not, no.

Thus, in the world, your subtle manner, your grace,

your most beautiful being, will be the object of endless praise,

and love, a simple duty.

translation.title: To Elizabeth
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the Spanish catalog's advice-like phrasing and compact moral turn.
